title: The Narrow Crack
text: The way on is a crack in the rock barely wide enough for a child, breathing cold air from somewhere far below. There are scratches on the stone inside, at shoulder height. Squeeze through as you are, and whoever carries the most is the one who sticks.

options.label: Squeeze through gear and all, and pray the one carrying most does not stick fast.

outcomes.text: They scrape through, swearing, leaving skin on the stone, and the rest follow easily.
They stick fast, and something far below breathes out. Getting them free costs skin and an hour of listening to it breathe.

options.label: Look for another way around, rather than crawl into the rock's throat.

outcomes.text: There is one. It is long, and dark, and full of the sound of dripping, and it seems to go on forever.
There is one, and something lives in it, and it is awake, and it is hungry.
